title: Senior Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Senior Developer (Palantir/PySpark) , who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

● English fluently

Palantir Foundry, Typescript, React JS, Workshop, Pyspark

· • Support Palantir Foundry Application Development by designing and developing full stack applications

Work on both frontend and backend components to ensure seamless integration and functionality.

  • Develop interactive workflow UIs and build/access data versions within the tool for analytics.
  • Support Palantir Foundry Application Development by designing and developing full stack applications
  • Work on both frontend and backend components to ensure seamless integration and functionality.
  • Improve application User Interface and visualization design
  • Implement operational applications using Foundry Tools (Workshop, Quiver, and Slate).
  • Develop interactive workflow UIs and build/access data versions within the tool for analytics.
  • Develop writeback functionality into the tool as needed.
  • Implement data visualizations using Foundry Tools (Quiver and Contour) and/or Power BI.
  • Maintain applications as usage grows and requirements change.
  • Develop data pipelines using PySpark to create datasets, Foundry objects, and User Interface applications.
  • Collaborate with the Data Engineering Team to understand the ontology and data pipelines supporting the applications.
  • Support end-to-end data pipeline development using Python and PySpark for ETL processes.
  • Support designing and building high-scale data-intensive workflows.
  • Perform data validations and analysis, using PyTest to create and implement unit tests.
  • Implement Foundry Expectations within Foundry Health checks for automated validations.
  • Monitor and debug critical issues such as data staleness or data quality.
  • Develop and execute unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end tests to ensure software quality.
  • Debug and resolve issues reported by users or identified through testing
  • Palantir

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Software Engineer
description:
Salary: $3000 - $3500 / month

Location: Remote

Working Hours: Brazil Time

Employment Type: Full-Time



About the Role

As a Software Engineer, you’ll build internal tools, automations, and dashboards that eliminate bottlenecks and drive serious ROI for fast-growing businesses.


We’re an AI-driven engineering team. You’ll be using AI tools heavily to speed up development. Your job isn’t to write every line from scratch — it’s to guide the AI, review its output, and make sure everything that ships is clean, scalable, and production-ready. AI can write code, but only a human can exercise strong judgment around architecture, performance, and long-term maintainability.


You’ll own your projects end-to-end and see exactly how your work impacts real businesses — not in theory, but through direct feedback and measurable results. The tools you build will help 7- and 8- figure companies grow faster and save +$100K in expenses. If you want to sharpen your skills, make meaningful technical decisions, and be part of where software engineering is headed in the age of AI — this is the role.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and build custom internal tools and AI-driven applications that eliminate manual work
  • Build and maintain REST APIs, backend servers, and databases
  • Develop primarily with custom code (Python), using no-code platforms (Make, Airtable) where they make architectural sense
  • Create dashboards that give C-suite visibility into key business metrics


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 2+ years of professional backend software engineering experience (Python preferred), including shipping and maintaining production systems
  • Experience building REST APIs and production-grade servers
  • Experience making and defending technical decisions (e.g. database design, API structure, performance vs speed tradeoffs)
  • Designing and implementing databases (SQL or No-SQL)
  • Fluent English — written and spoken


Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with No-Code Automation Tools like Make, Zapier, N8N
  • Experience setting up project management tools like AirTable, Monday.com, or Asana


Why Join Us?

  • Get hands-on experience building solutions at the bleeding edge of AI + automation
  • Work directly with founders and see how multi-7 and 8-figure businesses actually run
  • Build a portfolio of systems that save companies $100K+ per year


Please Note: This role is not a pure no-code or automation-only position. Strong software engineering fundamentals are required.

title: VMware Infrastructure / Storage
description:
Mandatory Skills Description:


  • Operating System Proficiency, including Linux (primarily RHEL and Rocky)
  • Server Hardware Management
  • Virtualization, especially VMware
  • Network Management, including DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP
  • Security, including best practices, patch management, vulnerability assessments
  • Monitoring and Troubleshooting



Project Description:


  • Our Client is one of the largest TV providers in North America. We are looking for VMWare Administrator to maintain security, performance monitoring, Installing, configuring, securing, managing, and monitoring VMware vSphere ESXi clusters in multiple data centers.


Responsibilities:


  • Installation, configuration, maintenance, tuning and troubleshooting of VMware environment running on vSphere 6.5, 6.7, 7, 8.
  • Installation of ESXi Host and vCenter Server
  • Upgrading ESXi
  • Responsible for ESXI Host Server Health Check and Performance Monitoring
  • Experience working with VCF, vCenter, vSphere, vROPs
  • Upgrade VM Tools and VM Hardware versions
  • Monitor and remediate security compliance results from tool like Nessus/Tenable
  • Perform VMware crash/error analysis, Root Cause Analysis, Coordinate Post Problem Analysis and Trend Analysis
  • Basic Linux administration
  • On-call support

title: Senior Salesforce Business Analyst
description:
Job Title: Senior Salesforce Business Analyst

Duration: 6 months

Location: LATAM (Remote)

Need to support PST timings


Description:

Cohesity is seeking a Senior Salesforce Business Analyst to join our fast-growing Go-to Market Systems team. This person will be a high-level strategic contributor that understands and documents the internal customer’s business requirements. You will work with internal developers and create functional specifications that meet those requirements and test the developed functionality. As the primary business systems liaison to the Channel sales team, you will be responsible for designing, managing, and improving our Salesforce Community. Direct experience solutioning for Salesforce Communities. You will lead discovery and analysis sessions with stakeholders and help business teams derive unambiguous business rules and requirements that can be translated into actionable specifications for development teams.

  • Responsible for business requirement understanding, Writing JIRA User Stories, Sprint planning, backlog grooming, and working with the development team for planning and solutioning.
  • Work closely with other teams to understand current and future requirements; suggest solutions and alternatives - transform business processes through technology. This person will be hands-on and will need to be an expert in the Salesforce Community platform.
  • Facilitate design, implementation, maintenance and enhancement of the SFDC Community application as well as other declarative parts of the Salesforce platform.
  • Develop and configure Salesforce Gainsight solutions, including customer health scoring, success plans, journey orchestration, lifecycle management, and reporting to enable proactive customer success initiatives.
  • Implement AI-driven automation and intelligence using Salesforce Einstein, predictive case routing, sentiment analysis, intelligent recommendations, and automated workflows to improve service efficiency and customer experience.
  • Partner with business domain leaders to create a robust Enterprise Application roadmap. Ensure this roadmap is well understood throughout the business functions and meet emerging requirements. Take the abstract of this roadmap down to threads of executional framework.
  • Collaborate with other Business Systems Analyst and Product Managers in both the US and offshore locations to drive the work
  • Support existing Partner community solutions (and related applications), working on production support, trouble-shooting issues, and implementing small to large enhancements.
  • Deliver Salesforce platform updates as a key member responsible for the design, development and release of strategic projects.
  • Specify implementation of standards, methods, and procedures for inspecting, testing, and evaluating the precision and reliability of applications and software
  • Ensure Application Development initiatives and projects are well managed and deliver on expectations - functionality, timeliness, and cost
  • Able to foster a culture of transparency and a sense of purpose among the team, and create clear accountabilities and metrics


Professional Experience/Qualifications:

  • Has successfully led development and delivery of multiple complex business technology solutions into production that have achieved or surpassed business goals.
  • Experience developing and supporting mission critical applications optimized to run in the cloud or virtualized environments.
  • Deep knowledge of system architecture, technical design, and system and software
  • development technology.


Required Skills / Experiences:

  • 6+ years of IT experience with a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, Computer Engineering or equivalent technical degree
  • 3+ years of experience as a business analyst/product manager supporting Salesforce Community platform.
  • Deep understanding of the Salesforce.com product suite including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, FSL, Community Cloud, and the AppExchange.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce Gainsight, including configuration, data modeling, rules engine, success plans, and reporting (or strong experience integrating Gainsight with Salesforce).
  • Knowledge of Customer Success metrics (Health Score, NPS, CSAT, Renewal Risk)
  • Experience implementing AI-powered automation within Salesforce using Einstein AI, predictive insights, and intelligent workflows.
  • Experience with Einstein Bots, Digital Engagement, and AI-driven service analytics
  • Managing application development at scale, employing SDLC methodologies including Agile, Scrum, and DevOps
  • Skilled at setting and communicating priorities effectively; able to manage multiple tasks and priorities
  • Exceptional ability to lead change using positive and collaborative methods
  • Strong communication skills in writing, speaking, and presenting
  • Able to communicate technical or complex subject matter in business terms
  • Accepts ownership and welcomes responsibility

title: 销售工程师
description:
Company Overview

Renepoly (Official Website: ) is a provider of smart microgrid and energy storage solutions in the new energy industry. Our products cover commercial & industrial energy storage and utility-scale energy storage systems, coupled with a self-developed Energy Management System (EMS). We are committed to delivering one-stop clean energy project services for governments, industrial parks, commercial complexes and new energy enterprises.


Equipped with our own manufacturing facility, we boast a solid track record of project delivery, a diversified resource network, as well as an experienced R&D and after-sales team. We have successfully implemented multiple megawatt-scale energy storage and microgrid demonstration projects, with our business scope covering smart energy management, grid peak-shaving, renewable energy grid integration and other fields.


Job Description:

1. Responsible for sales of energy products in Brazil and surrounding markets.

2. Develop new clients, maintain existing relationships, and drive order closures.

3. Manage local warehouse operations and perform basic inventory management.

4. Accompany clients to project sites/warehouse for equipment demonstrations and conduct customer visits.

5. Proactively identify potential clients and expand market share in the new energy storage sector.


Requirements:

1. Bachelor’s degree or above, with 5+ years of sales experience in new energy, electrical, EPC, PV, or energy storage.

2. Background in new energy vehicles, equipment, or engineering industries.

3. Fluency in Spanish and Portuguese, and English.

4. Ability to independently develop clients and execute sales tasks with a proactive approach.

6. Experience in warehouse or inventory management is a plus.

7. Update the progress of customer follow-up weekly.

8. Hold regular business progress reporting meetings with the Director of Foreign Trade and the General Manager of the Americas every two weeks.



Join us and share the green-economy opportunity!

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
About Us

Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


About Your Team

At Teachable, our Data team aims to support company data-driven decision-making. Reporting to the Head of Data, you will collaborate with business and product teams to validate hypotheses, answer complex business questions, help the company in uncertain scenarios, perform data experiments, and disseminate actionable insights.


About You

You will take the lead in exploring data and cross-business variables, uncovering patterns and trends, identifying new data sources, and delivering valuable insights to various departments.


What You’ll Do:

  • Develop and execute complex data analyses using statistical techniques and modeling to validate business hypotheses.
  • Detect patterns, trends and anomalies in data and translate them into actionable insights that drive strategic decisions and business growth.
  • Serve as a key expert in data analysis, providing guidance and best practices to team members and stakeholders across the company.


What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years of experience within data analytics and/or data science.
  • Strong curiosity for uncovering insights from data.
  • Proven experience in delivering data studies focused on generating and sharing actionable data.
  • Deep understanding of statistical methods, including hypothesis testing and statistical modeling.
  • Proficiency in SQL for extracting data directly from source systems.
  • Sharp critical thinking and analytical problem-solving abilities.
  • Enjoy working in a dynamic environment with fast learning and deliveries.
  • Advanced English proficiency (conversational, listening, writing.)


Nice to Have:

  • Ability to perform data cleaning and processing steps using Python or R languages.
  • Hands-on experience in building Machine Learning models.


This is a fully remote role based in Brazil, and you’ll collaborate closely with teams across the U.S. and Brazil. Your work will follow Brasilia Standard Time, and you’ll be hired as a CLT contract employee with compensation in BRL.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
About Us

Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


About Your Team

At Teachable, our Data team aims to support company data-driven decision-making. Reporting to the Head of Data, you will collaborate with business and product teams to validate hypotheses, answer complex business questions, help the company in uncertain scenarios, perform data experiments, and disseminate actionable insights.


About You

You will take the lead in exploring data and cross-business variables, uncovering patterns and trends, identifying new data sources, and delivering valuable insights to various departments.


What You’ll Do:

  • Develop and execute complex data analyses using statistical techniques and modeling to validate business hypotheses.
  • Detect patterns, trends and anomalies in data and translate them into actionable insights that drive strategic decisions and business growth.
  • Serve as a key expert in data analysis, providing guidance and best practices to team members and stakeholders across the company.


What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years of experience within data analytics and/or data science.
  • Strong curiosity for uncovering insights from data.
  • Proven experience in delivering data studies focused on generating and sharing actionable data.
  • Deep understanding of statistical methods, including hypothesis testing and statistical modeling.
  • Proficiency in SQL for extracting data directly from source systems.
  • Sharp critical thinking and analytical problem-solving abilities.
  • Enjoy working in a dynamic environment with fast learning and deliveries.
  • Advanced English proficiency (conversational, listening, writing.)


Nice to Have:

  • Ability to perform data cleaning and processing steps using Python or R languages.
  • Hands-on experience in building Machine Learning models.


This is a fully remote role based in Brazil, and you’ll collaborate closely with teams across the U.S. and Brazil. Your work will follow Brasilia Standard Time, and you’ll be hired as a CLT contract employee with compensation in BRL.

title: Exchange Administrator
description:
About the Role:

Our client is looking for an experienced professional with a strong focus on the administration and support of Microsoft solutions. The ideal candidate will have solid experience managing corporate environments and working with mission-critical technologies that ensure business continuity. This role requires availability to participate in an on-call rotation and the ability to communicate in English with global teams. The position is offered under a contractor model.


Responsibilities:

  • Administer and maintain Exchange 2016 and Office 365 environments, ensuring platform availability, stability, and performance.
  • Manage and optimize Active Directory environments, including security policies, authentication, and organizational structures.
  • Create, review, and automate processes using PowerShell to increase efficiency and operational control.
  • Provide advanced-level technical support and troubleshooting, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives, system migrations, and upgrades.
  • Be available to participate in an on-call rotation schedule, responding to incidents and critical issues as needed.


Requirements:

  • Proven experience with Exchange 2016, including maintenance, configuration, and troubleshooting.
  • Strong experience with Office 365, focusing on identity administration, licensing, and end-user support.
  • Solid hands-on experience with Active Directory, including DNS, Group Policies (GPOs), and authentication.
  • Advanced PowerShell skills, with the ability to build and maintain scripts for automation and problem resolution.
  • Conversational English is required, as the role involves interaction with international teams and stakeholders.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in a team-oriented environment.
  • Availability to work under a contractor model.


Preferred Skills:

  • Microsoft certifications related to the responsibilities of the role.
  • AWS experience is a plus.

title: Data Scientist  [Modelos Clássicos] - [Banco de Talentos]
description:
Estamos formando um Banco de Talentos para profissionais de Data Science com especialização em Métodos Clássicos .

O objetivo é identificar talentos para futuras oportunidades voltadas ao desenvolvimento de soluções inteligentes baseadas em dados não estruturados e IA generativa, apoiando desafios estratégicos da organização.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Desenvolver soluções preditivas utilizando métodos clássicos de machine learning , incluindo: Regressão (linear e logística), classificação modelos de séries temporais, arvores de decisão, gradient Boosting (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost) e KNN;

Conduzir análises exploratórias completas (EDA), identificando padrões, inconsistências e oportunidades de transformação dos dados;

Executar pré-processamento avançado: limpeza, normalização, encoding, tratamento de outliers e balanceamento;

Selecionar e construir variáveis relevantes (feature engineering), aplicando técnicas estatísticas e conhecimento de negócio;

Implementar modelos preditivos com foco em performance, interpretabilidade e impacto estratégico;

Validar modelos utilizando métricas adequadas, técnicas de cross-validation e tuning de hiperparâmetros;

Atuar diretamente com o cliente, participando de discussões de backlog, refinamento de requisitos e proposição de melhorias técnicas e de processo;

Documentar análises, decisões técnicas e resultados de forma clara e estruturada.



Requisitos e qualificações

Experiência prática com Python aplicado a ciência de dados e machine learning;

Experiência com métodos clássicos de machine learning;

Vivência com Databricks ;

Experiência com plataformas de nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP);

Domínio de técnicas de validação de modelos, tuning de hiperparâmetros e métricas de avaliação (AUC, F1, RMSE, MAPE etc.).

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
Sobre a BRQ Digital

Código da oportunidade: 57333


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei , venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!

title: Lead Data Architect – Azure Databricks & Advanced
description:
Lead Data Architect – Azure Databricks & Advanced Analytics


Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Lead Data Architect with deep expertise in Azure Databricks and advanced analytics to design and deliver scalable, cloud-native data solutions. This role requires strong hands-on technical skills combined with architectural leadership to drive end-to-end analytics platforms aligned with business objectives.

The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience in big data technologies, data engineering, and Azure cloud services, with a strong focus on Databricks, SQL, and modern data lakehouse architectures.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of advanced analytics solutions using Azure Databricks and Microsoft Fabric
  • Collaborate closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional IT teams to gather requirements and translate them into effective data solutions
  • Own end-to-end delivery of data platforms, ensuring alignment with business needs, architectural standards, and best practices
  • Design and develop scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes using Azure Databricks, PySpark, and related tools
  • Integrate Azure Databricks with other Azure services, including Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory , and on-premise systems
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to data engineering teams, fostering continuous learning and innovation
  • Ensure comprehensive documentation of data architectures, pipelines, and data flows
  • Enforce best practices for code quality, data security, governance, and scalability
  • Stay current with evolving Databricks and Azure technologies to drive continuous improvement and innovation


Essential Technical Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with Azure Databricks , including cluster management, notebook development, and Delta Lake
  • Proficiency in big data technologies such as Spark, Hadoop , and data processing frameworks like PySpark
  • Deep understanding of Azure services including Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS Gen2), Azure Synapse, and Azure Data Factory
  • Experience designing and implementing ETL/ELT pipelines, data lakes, and data warehouses
  • Advanced SQL skills and familiarity with NoSQL databases
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and version control systems such as Git
  • Strong knowledge of cloud security and governance best practices


Soft Skills

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Strong problem-solving mindset with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues
  • Proven leadership and mentoring skills, with experience leading and guiding data engineering teams


Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with Power BI for dashboarding and reporting
  • Exposure to Microsoft Fabric for analytics and integration workloads
  • Knowledge of Spark Streaming for real-time data processing
  • Familiarity with Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices


Experience Requirements

  • 12+ years of demonstrated experience in developing data ingestion and transformation pipelines using Databricks, Azure Synapse notebooks, and Azure Data Factory
  • Strong hands-on experience with Delta Tables, Delta Lake, and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2
  • Proven expertise using Auto Loader and Delta Live Tables for efficient data ingestion and transformation
  • Experience building and optimizing query layers using Databricks SQL
  • Demonstrated experience integrating Databricks with Azure Synapse, ADLS Gen2, and Power BI for end-to-end analytics solutions
  • Prior experience developing, optimizing, and deploying Power BI reports
  • Solid understanding of modern CI/CD practices , particularly for Databricks and cloud-native architectures

title: SAP Mobile Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for (job name) who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Work as part of SAP Empowered Product Teams, design, develop, and maintain frontend application features for cross platform mobile SAP Service and Asset Manager.

Follow SAP’s development standard, efficient use of standard and SAP mobile technology in development and testing, such as SAP BTP Mobile Services, SAP Mobile Development Kit, JavaScript, TypeScript, Visual Studio Code, Xcode, Android Studio, ilodata, SQL, Ultralite DB, Appium, Java, SAP Business Application Studio, Github, CI/CD with Hyperspace Fastlane, OData Services, SAP Gateway, S/4HANA system etc.

Actively collaborate with product manager to clarify on customer problem, feature requirement

Actively collaborate with UX designers to ensure seamless and visually appealing user experience following SAP Fiori Design Guidelines for each platform, iOS, Android and Windows, and figma design for the application.

Ensure high performance and responsiveness of developed features

Actively collaborate with backend integration service developers to align on OData Service features and requirement, to ensure seamless integration in frontend logic

Use S/4HANA system and its relevant business processes (Plant Maintenance, Quality Management, Material Management, Inventory Management, Extended Warehouse Management, Work Clearance Management etc), and data objects (Work Order, Notification, PM Confirmation, Timesheet, Service Order, Service Confirmation, Service Quotation, Equipment, Functional Location, Material Master etc), setup necessary test data in S/4HANA system, perform end-to-end test, and validate developed features against S/4HANA system.

Conduct thorough testing, including unit testing, integration test, and UI automation test scripts for developed features

Actively collaborate with quality engineers on issues reported, debug, identify and fix bugs, crashes, and performance issues

Provide sufficient documentations on features developed

Collaborate with user assistance developer (technical writer) to provide information on product features developed to be used in product documentation

Follow agile development principles and best practice during development

Participate in daily scrums

Participate in backlog grooming, and able to provide good quality effort estimates

Provide quick investigation and resolution to assigned customer incident from ServiceNow. Follow standard customer incident support process, ensure timely investigation, proper communication with customer, proper documentation in ServicewNow incident, and resolution of issues within standard SLA based on criticality of the customer incident. Create necessary JIRA issue for tracking, and SAP Note to provide resolution and fixes.

Maintain communication and documentation in English

Maintain proper communication and notification with lead MDK developer and SAP development manager on vacation or absence to ensure minimum impact to development timeline


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Analista de Projetos Pleno
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:


Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas.

Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente!


Sobre a área: O escritório de projetos atua na padronização de processos de governanç arelacionados ag estão de projetos, facilitando o compartilhamento de reports, metodologias, ferramentas e técnicas para alcançar o desafio deimplementar iniciativas com sucesso. O Analista de Projetos elabora planos de execução e acompanha deperto os projetos do Grupo Fleury, atuando também no controle e nos estudos, garantindo que todas asinformações obtidas desse projeto sejam registradas e estejam em um local de fácil consulta


Principais atividades:


  • Entender com profundidade o projeto que será trabalhado, com enfoque no valor que será gerado;
  • Agir em conformidade à metodologia estabelecida pelo Escritório de Projetos (PMO), ser um administrador diligente, respeitoso e atencioso;
  • Apoiar o superior imediato em assuntos inerentes à sua área de atuação, apresentando e discutindosoluções para problemas e irregularidades, a fim de subsidiar a definição de ações a serem adotadas eauxiliar na busca pelo melhoramento contínuo dos processos da área;
  • Criar um ambiente colaborativo para a equipe de projeto;
  • Mapear e envolver stakeholders;
  • Otimizar as respostas aos riscos;
  • Adequar o projeto de acordo com o contexto, adotando uma capacidade de adaptação e resiliência;
  • Realizar acompanhamento ativo de pendências;
  • Incluir critérios de aceitação nas entregas para garantia da qualidade e atendimento de expectativas
  • Executar outras tarefas correlatas, do mesmo grau de dificuldade mediante solicitação do superiorimediato


Buscamos alguém que apresente:


  • Pacote Office – intermediário
  • MS Project – básico
  • Métodos ágeis – básico
  • Experiência prévia na condução de projetos de diferentes portes e complexidades
  • Superior Completo (Administração, Engenharia, TI ou áreas correlatas)?MBA em Gestão de Projetos (desejável)


Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito


Informações da vaga:

  • Modelo de Trabalho (Home Office)
  • Carga Horária: 44h Semanais
  • Escala: Segunda a sexta - feira
  • Horário de Trabalho: 08h00 ás 17h48


Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!


Saúde e Bem-estar:

• Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;

• Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;

• Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;

• Acesso à plataforma OrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;

• Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas;

• Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida.


Proteção e estabilidade:

• Previdência privada;

• Participação nos lucros;

• Seguro de vida.


Facilidades para o dia a dia:

• Vale-Alimentação;

• Vale-Refeição;

• Auxílio-Creche;

• Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços.


Desenvolvimento e educação:

• Plataforma de ensino;

• Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições.


Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.


Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.


Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família.

title: Engenheiro de dados SR
description:
A Stone:

Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.


Como é ser um Egenheiro de Dados:

O Engenheiro de Dados será responsável por construir, implantar e otimizar pipelines de dados confiáveis e escaláveis, garantindo que os dados brutos sejam transformados em informações úteis e acessíveis para a tomada de decisões estratégicas e segmentação de jornadas no contexto de CRM. O profissional trabalhará em estreita colaboração com analistas de negócios e equipes de TI para suportar diversas iniciativas orientadas por dados.


As suas principais responsabilidades serão:

  • Criar e gerenciar pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT): Desenvolver fluxos automatizados e confiáveis para extrair, transformar e carregar dados de diversas fontes, utilizando ferramentas de orquestração.
  • Assegurar a qualidade dos dados: Implementar processos para monitorar a qualidade e a integridade dos dados, identificando e corrigindo falhas na estrutura para evitar comprometimento das análises e jornadas.
  • Otimizar performance: Monitorar o desempenho dos sistemas de dados e implementar melhorias para garantir o processamento rápido e eficiente de consultas e análises.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência em SQL (Procedures, DML, DDL, Pipelines) & Python.
  • Plataformas de Nuvem: Experiência com serviços de nuvem (GCP, Amplitude, Salesforce Marketing Cloud) para armazenamento e processamento de dados.
  • Ferramentas de orquestração: Airflow e Cloud Functions.
  • Engenharia de Software: Conhecimento em boas práticas de codificação, versionamento (Git) e testes.
  • Capacidade de Resolução de Problemas e Pensamento Crítico: Habilidade analítica para identificar gargalos, depurar sistemas complexos e encontrar soluções eficazes de forma proativa.
  • Comunicação Eficaz: Clareza para explicar conceitos técnicos complexos para públicos não técnicos (como times de negócios e gestão), e vice-versa, garantindo o alinhamento de expectativas e resultados.
  • Trabalho em Equipe e Colaboração: Atuar de forma integrada com engenheiros de dados, analistas e outras equipes, contribuindo para um ambiente produtivo e sinérgico.
  • Orientação para Resultados: Foco em entregar soluções de dados que gerem valor real para o negócio e impulsionam a tomada de decisões.


Jornada de Trabalho:

  • CLT: 8 horas diárias + 1h de intervalo | Escala: 5x2 Segunda à sexta - de 08h às 17h ou de 09h às 18h.


Modelo/Local de trabalho:

  • Remoto


Etapas do Processo Seletivo

✍Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro e alguns testes. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!

Entrevistas com o time de People: Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.

Case/ Entrevista com a Liderança: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.

✅Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.


Nossa Cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Software
description:
Somos uma empresa de tecnologia criada para transformar o mercado de serviços financeiros no Brasil e na América Latina. Estamos crescendo rápido, integrando novos negócios, acelerando inovação e construindo com intenção e consistência a cultura que sustentará nosso futuro.

Cultura, para nós, não é discurso: é sistema, prática e forma de operar.

E agora buscamos alguém que venha construir isso junto.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


SUA MISSÃO:

A pessoa coordenadora atua como uma ponte entre a estratégia macro e a execução, garantindo que os times de Product Owners/Managers, Frontend e Backend tenham os recursos, a orientação e o ambiente necessários para entregar valor constante ao negócio.

Seu principal foco será o desenvolvimento de talentos, excelência operacional e entrega tática.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

• Gestão de Pessoas: Liderar, mentorar e desenvolver a equipe, realizando 1:1s, planos de desenvolvimento individual (PDI) e avaliações de desempenho.

• Alinhamento Tático: Garantir que as squads sob sua coordenação estejam alinhadas com os

OKRs da área e que as dependências entre times sejam gerenciadas com eficiência.

• Refinamento de Processos: Implementar e otimizar metodologias de discovery e delivery, garantindo agilidade e qualidade sem burocracia excessiva.

• Interface com Stakeholders: Atuar como ponto de apoio para áreas parceiras (Vendas, CX,

Engenharia), traduzindo prioridades e gerenciando expectativas de curto e médio prazo.

• Suporte ao Discovery: Apoiar o time na validação de hipóteses e na construção de roadmaps realistas e baseados em dados.


O QUE ESPERAMOS QUE VOCÊ SAIBA:

• Experiência sólida como Desenvolvedor; domínio de metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban); conhecimento em métricas de produto (NPS, Churn, LTV, conversão); experiência com ferramentas de gestão (Jira, Notion, etc.).

• Liderança servidora, habilidade em resolução de conflitos, comunicação clara e assertiva, capacidade de dar e receber feedbacks construtivos e organização multitarefa.

• Conhecimento básico em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação para backend nas linguagens Ruby on Rails, Java, C#, Node.js, Python, PHP.

• Noções de bancos de dados relacionais e linguagem SQL (ex: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL

Server).

Conhecimento básico sobre o funcionamento de APis REST.

• Domínio de um framework (React, Vue, Angular) e seu ecossistema.

• Profundo conhecimento em gerenciamento de estado (Redux, Vuex, Zustand, etc.).

• Experiência sólida com ferramentas de build (Webpack, Vite) e pré-processadores

(SASS).

• Habilidade em criar e manter testes automatizados (Jest, Cypress).

• ¡OS Nativo (Swift):

• Domínio de padrões de arquitetura (MVVM, VIPER).

• Profundo conhecimento em SwiftUl e/ou UIKit para layouts complexos.

• Experiência com gerenciamento de dependências (Swift Package Manager, CocoaPods) e concorrência (GCD, Swift Concurrency).

• Android Nativo (Kotlin):

• Domínio de padrões de arquitetura (MVVM, MVI) e dos componentes Jetpack.

• Profundo conhecimento em Jetpack Compose e/ou XML para layouts complexos.

• Experiência com Coroutines/Flow para programação assíncrona e Dagger/Hilt para injeção de dependência.

• Flutter (Dart):

• Domínio de padrões de gerenciamento de estado avançados (BLoC, Riverpod).

• Habilidade em criar widgets customizados e complexos.

• Experiência com canais de plataforma (platform channels) para integração com código nativo.

• Mentalidade Orientada a Dados: Capacidade de tomar decisões baseadas em evidências.

• Empatia pelo Cliente: Um desejo profundo de entender e resolver os problemas dos usuários.

• Espírito Colaborativo: Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe com desenvolvedores, designers, marketing e outras áreas.

• Resiliência e Adaptação: Capacidade de navegar em ambientes de incerteza e mudar de curso

quando necessário.


O Que Oferecemos:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Desenvolvedor Java Back-end
description:
Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Back-end Java para atuar em um ambiente de alta criticidade , com foco em integrações, mensageria e microsserviços , participando ativamente do desenvolvimento de soluções robustas e escaláveis.


Stack Tecnológico

Obrigatório:

  • Java 11+;
  • Spring Boot;
  • APIs REST;
  • RabbitMQ;
  • MongoDB;
  • Oracle.

Desejável:

  • Kafka;
  • Redis;
  • Docker;
  • Kubernetes / OpenShift;
  • Observabilidade (Datadog, AppDynamics, ELK).

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Criar e consumir filas RabbitMQ (listeners para eventos de renovação e cancelamento).
  • Implementar integrações REST com sistemas como BCP, Bureau, Dossiê, Sinistro e Vistoria Prévia.
  • Desenvolver endpoints para geração de ofertas APA / AFI.
  • Realizar manutenção e ajustes em tabelas Oracle.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de Clean Code, SOLID e Design Patterns.
  • Participar de code reviews e pair programming.
  • Garantir cobertura de testes unitários (JUnit, Mockito).

Requisitos Técnicos

Obrigatórios:

  • 3+ anos de experiência com Java e Spring Boot em produção.
  • Experiência sólida com microsserviços e APIs REST.
  • Conhecimento em mensageria (RabbitMQ ou Kafka).
  • Domínio de bancos relacionais (Oracle/PostgreSQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB).
  • Versionamento de código com Git / GitLab.

Diferenciais:

title: Brazil - Remote: Tech Lead
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.


Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  • Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  • Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  • Frontend: Building the \"Control Room\" and complex AI interfaces.
  • DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together. ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s \"Visualizations\" and that the \"Data Pipelines\" are reliably deployed by DevOps.


What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The \"Expert\": When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translating high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.


Qualifications

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.


Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud


Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.


Halliburton is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.


Location

Fully Remote position.


Job Details

Requisition Number:

Experience Level: Mid to Senior

Job Family: Engineering/Science/Technology

Product Service Line: Landmark Software & Services

Full Time / Part Time: Full Time

Employee Group: Temporary

title: International Group Holding – “Controller with CFO Track”
description:
Company Description

Home Alliance is a trusted on-demand resource for homeowners looking for local, reliable technicians. With a seamless booking process that takes less than a minute, customers can expect a confirmation within an hour and on-time service delivery. The company ensures quality by working exclusively with verified, experienced, licensed, and insured professionals, providing peace of mind for all home repair and maintenance needs.


About the Group

We are a diversified international holding company with operating businesses across multiple geographies and industries. As the group enters its next phase of growth and capital structuring, we are seeking a high-caliber Financial Controller with the ambition and capability to evolve into a Chief Financial Officer role.


The Role

This is a senior finance leadership position with full responsibility for group-level financial control, reporting, and governance. You will work closely with the CFO and Board, gaining exposure to strategic finance, M&A, funding, and long-term value creation.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead group financial reporting, consolidation, and statutory compliance across multiple entities
  • Own monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes
  • Design and strengthen internal controls, policies, and governance frameworks
  • Partner with operating company finance leads and senior management
  • Support budgeting, forecasting, and cash flow planning at group level
  • Participate in M&A, due diligence, and post-acquisition integration
  • Act as a key deputy to the CFO with increasing strategic responsibility


Ideal Profile

  • 8–12+ years of progressive finance experience, including group consolidation
  • Strong background in IFRS (or USA GAAP with IFRS exposure)
  • Experience in a holding company, PE-backed group, or multi-entity environment
  • Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CPA, or equivalent)
  • Leadership mindset with clear ambition to step into a CFO role within 2–4 years

title: Gerente de Technical Advisor
description:
Gerente de Technical Advisor (ArcGIS)


Descrição da vaga


  • Gerenciar e responder pela gestão do atendimento, fortalecendo o engajamento com o negócio das indústrias foco, em sinergia com Soluções, Marketing e Comercial, através da utilização de melhores práticas de ferramentas, processos e gestão de pessoas visando o aumento da qualidade percebida pelo cliente.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Elaborar, implantar e acompanhar a estratégia da área (planejamento, orçamento, cronograma e indicadores);
  • Participar da construção da estratégia de negócios dos clientes e da Diretoria;
  • Garantir o engajamento com a estratégia da Diretoria/Empresa, desdobrando todas as iniciativas com o time;
  • Acompanhar e oferecer visibilidade do andamento das entregas sob sua gestão;
  • Promover sinergia entre as áreas de Soluções e demais Diretorias/Áreas de empresa;
  • Orientar as áreas de negócios em relação as melhores práticas;
  • Identificar pontos de melhoria nos processos de vendas, desenvolvendo ações alinhadas com as necessidades dos processos das áreas de negócio;
  • Gestão do atendimento dos clientes garantindo o sucesso nos negócios utilizando nossos produtos e serviços
  • Atuar na elaboração e execução de um plano para a intensificação do uso das tecnologias adquiridas para alavancar seus processos de negócio;
  • Garantir que as demandas necessárias a estratégia de negócio do cliente, tenham os recursos e ações direcionadas conforme sua expectativa;
  • Garantir o atendimento especializado para contratos EA/EAP;
  • Trabalhar em sinergia com os Canais de Venda no desenvolvimento das contas e com a área de Suporte e Customer Success garantindo a satisfação dos clientes;
  • Acompanhar e oferecer visibilidade do andamento das entregas sob sua gestão;
  • Gestão de faturamento e custos;
  • Gestão da alocação dos profissionais conforme meta e políticas estabelecidas.
  • Elaborar, conferir e validar Relatórios Gerenciais para apoiar na tomada de decisões da empresa;
  • Promover o desenvolvimento de novos projetos, melhoria dos processos e das atividades compartilhadas ou interdependentes, identificando e aplicando boas práticas de mercado e realizando reuniões interdepartamentais;
  • Gerenciar atividades da área, estabelecendo cronogramas, indicadores de desempenho e orientando sobre a forma a se fazer cumprir as metas de produtividade dentro dos prazos estabelecidos e negociados, visando assegurar o cumprimento de todas as obrigações da empresa;
  • Negociar prazos para o fornecimento de informações pelas gerências, avaliar a qualidade destas e acompanhar o lançamento destes dados, visando assegurar a qualidade do relatório e sua entrega nos prazos estabelecidos;
  • Realizar a Gestão de Pessoas, acompanhar, avaliar e desenvolver o time;
  • Ser referência no exercício da nossa cultura, estar envolvido com nosso negócio, se interessar pelo desenvolvimento da sua área e da empresa como um todo
  • Realizar a gestão e controle orçamentário da área;
  • Realizar a gestão de Processos, adesão as Políticas de Qualidade e gestão de riscos e mudanças.


Requisitos e qualificações

Formação:

  • Graduado/Especializações.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Conhecimento em GIS (Geographic Information System), IT (Technology Information) em Estratégia de Empresas;
  • Conhecimentos em Planejamento Estratégico;
  • Conhecimento em análise de custos e orçamentos;
  • Gestão de Pessoas e Performance de Times;
  • Experiência com o ArcGIS;
  • Inglês Fluente/Avançado;
  • Análise e interpretação de dados.


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Mestrado;
  • Certificações Doutorado/Pós-Doutorado;
  • Conhecimento e compreensão em profundidade os produtos e serviços oferecidos pela Imagem.

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years of professional experience in C# and Angular or React.js to support the development, migration, and ongoing evolution of a platform. This role will play a key part in delivering new product initiatives, maintaining existing systems, and implementing a modernized architecture across multiple verticals.

The ideal candidate is technically strong across the stack, comfortable working within an established architectural vision, and proactive in taking ownership of implementation and delivery.


Our U.S. client is a fast-growing, mission-driven language technology company developing the next generation of interpretation and multilingual communication platforms. Their goal is to break down language barriers worldwide via cutting-edge speech and language AI powering solutions, such as video remote interpretation (VRI), over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), interpreter scheduling, simultaneous interpretation, and more.

Our client has remote teams across the U.S. as well as in Europe and the Philippines. The company has consistently achieved Net Promoter Scores (NPS) above 60, reflecting excellent customer satisfaction. The team is collaborative, inclusive, and highly engaged, with strong onboarding and growth support for new hires.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain full-stack features across web applications and backend services
  • Implement solutions aligned with architectural guidance provided by the architecture team
  • Contribute to the development of new products while maintaining and enhancing existing systems
  • Support the migration of legacy components into a modern microservices-based architecture
  • Build and maintain scalable backend services using C# , .NET , and SQL
  • Develop and maintain front-end functionality using Angular , with the
  • ability to quickly learn and adapt as needed
  • Collaborate across multiple product verticals and support a growing pipeline of new initiatives
  • Take technical ownership of assigned areas, leading implementation efforts and driving work forward
  • Partner closely with Product, Architecture, and Engineering teams to deliver on the broader technical vision


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 5+ years of professional experience as a software engineer in a full-stack capacity
  • Strong backend experience with C# , .NET , and SQL
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining microservices-based systems
  • Front-end development experience, ideally with Angular , or the ability to pick it up quickly
  • Experience working within an established architecture and implementing designs created by an architecture team
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work across multiple projects and verticals
  • Proactive, energetic mindset with a willingness to take ownership and lead by example


Preferred Experience

  • Experience participating in large-scale system migrations or platform modernization efforts
  • Exposure to cloud-based environments and distributed systems
  • Experience working in fast-paced environments with multiple concurrent initiatives


Additional Information

  • Know that your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • Own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart, creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them and be transparent!
  • Be recognized as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Desenvolvedor(a) SAP ABAP
description:
Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.

Estamos com uma oportunidade para o nosso time corporativo para: Desenvolvedor(a) SAP ABAP


Experiência Profissional


Inglês fluente ou avançado para escrita e conversação - Obrigatório


Requisitos


  • Excelente conhecimento em desenvolvimento ABAP no S/4, incluindo Steampunk e conceitos de SAP Clean Core
  • Conhecimento em criação de CDS Views , ODATA & REST e integração orientada por APIs .
  • Experiência em ABAP on S/4 HANA de 3 a 4 anos – CDS , AMDP (ABAP Managed Database Procedures) e table functions , RAP Framework (RESTful Application Programming)
  • Habilidades de integração no S/4 usando Rest API e SProxy
  • Experiência com Adobe Forms
  • Conhecimento do processo SolMan Charm
  • Conhecimento em pesquisa de SAP Notes como parte do tratamento de defeitos. Registrar OSS-cases na SAP e instalar SAP Notes
  • Conhecimento em instalação e/ou ativação de versões de países do S/4
  • Conhecimento em instalação de namespaces para integração com sistemas legais
  • Inglês fluente ou avançado para escrita e conversação - Obrigatório
  • Conhecimento em tributação do Brasil
  • Conhecimento em tributação do Peru e do Chile será um diferencial
  • Espanhol será um diferencial


Formação Acadêmica


  • Graduação completa.


Modelo de trabalho:


  • Remoto

title: Devops Engineer (Projeto Internacional)
description:
Se você busca uma oportunidade na área de Tecnologia da Informação, tem organização, boa comunicação e vontade de crescer, essa vaga 100% remoto e CLT, pode ser para você.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência sólida com DevOps atuando com Saas/PaaS e plataformas de serviços;
  • Experiência com CI/CD, plataforma Azure (Kubernetes / SQL / AppGW / Key Vault);
  • Experiência com Jira e distribuição Linux;
  • Experiência com suporte operacional por meio de solução de problemas e análise de erros, garantindo o registro e monitoramento eficientes e solução de problemas confiável;
  • Idioma Inglês Avançado (terá inteirações internacionais).


Responsabilidades:

Esse profissional será responsável por provisionar, configurar e manter ambientes em nuvem, utilizando ferramentas (principalmente plataforma Azure) para garantir escalabilidade, estabilidade e segurança dos sistemas.

Além disso, é essencial o domínio em administração de sistemas Linux, com conhecimento em roteamento, estratégias de firewall e gestão de certificados. O profissional também atuará no suporte operacional, realizando análises de erros e troubleshooting, assegurando que os ambientes estejam corretamente logados, monitorados e performando de forma eficiente. Ter conhecimento ou interesse em práticas de CI/CD é valorizado, assim como disposição para trabalhar com ferramentas colaborativas como SharePoint e Jira.

Buscamos alguém com perfil proativo, analítico e orientado à automação, que contribua ativamente para a melhoria contínua dos processos e da infraestrutura


O que oferecemos:

  • Ambiente colaborativo e multicultural.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento profissional em uma das líderes globais em tecnologia.
  • Pacote de benefícios completo - PLR, VR, Gympass, Previdência, Convênios, etc.

title: SAP S/4HANA Business Systems Analyst – (E-invoice)
description:
We are seeking an experienced SAP S/4HANA Business Systems Analyst to expand our E-invoice integrations offering.


Job responsibilities/ Role Requirements include:

• Provide subject matter expertise on tax determination, reporting and compliance (including e-invoicing)

• Perform detailed analysis, feasibility, and integration design of business processes within SAP S/4HANA modules (MM, SD, and FI) to the integration

• Assist in project management, implementation planning and test approach / planning

• Solid understanding of tax data flow between organizational systems, technical architecture, integrations, and data pipelines between ERP and Tax/ compliance systems.

• Excellent communication skills and ability to work cross functionally with other Functional Consultants, Developers/ Architects, Sales, Professional Services, Customer Support, Tax Research, Customers and Prospects

• Prepare detailed Functional Specification documentation with use cases, PowerPoint presentations, and other documents to explain requirements internally and externally.

• Support the product development process, working closely with Development, QA and Documentation teams throughout the whole product life cycle, feature validating functionality, as well as preparing the rest of the organization for product release.

• Assist with end-user documentation, process flows, specifications, and diagrams to provide direction to customers, partners and professional services, and support teams.

• Support product rollouts and implementations as domain expert and/or primary business interface to other parties.

• Follow product into the field to ensure customer success, providing business and data integration expertise to customers, partners and internal professional services personnel as needed.

• Assist in providing 2nd level support and training to Customer Support, Professional Services, and integration partners.

• Provide business expertise in sales calls as needed.


Qualifications

• Working experience in SAP localization requirements

• Working experience in Indirect Tax Compliance and E- Invoicing

• Experience in SAP S/4HANA configuration and implementation (FI, SD or MM) and Strong knowledge in various SAP business processes in FI, SD and MM and cross module integrations.


We are digital changemakers – here to disrupt old ideas, blaze new trails, and help enterprises transform and scale at unparalleled speed.

Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente!


Principais atividades:


  • Realizar venda e o pós-venda para laboratórios credenciados, concretizando a negociação dos contratos e providenciando a capacitação dos clientes, para atingir os resultados projetados;
  • Levantar novas oportunidades de convênio na região de atuação, realizando a venda dos serviços oferecidos pela empresa, para garantir os resultados esperados;
  • Atuar na recuperação de clientes, apurando os problemas e propondo ações para concretização de novas vendas; Realizar visitas de acompanhamento, a fim de identificar dificuldades e pontos de melhoria no atendimento ao cliente; Realizar a interface entre instituição x parceria, informando aos convênios atualização de portfólio;
  • Pesquisar como estão as ações e preços praticados pelo mercado concorrente;
  • Administrar a carteira de clientes, acompanhando o crescimento x queda de utilização dos serviços na sua área de atuação;
  • Apurar os problemas e identificar ações de recuperação de clientes, com foco na solução preventiva e corretiva; Auxiliar nas negociações financeiras com os laboratórios conveniados;
  • Apresentar os novos instrumentos de gestão ou de processo de informação dos serviços aos clientes chaves, para obter melhorias nas relações comerciais;
  • Participar de Licitações, quando necessário.



Buscamos alguém que apresente:


  • Formação Superior Completa em Biomedicina, Farmácia ou Ciências Biológicas;
  • Experiência na área comercial;
  • Experiência na área laboratorial;
  • CNH - B (habilidade na direção- será realizado teste de habilidade);
  • Disponibilidade para viagens semanais.



Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.


Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:


• Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;

• Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;

• Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;

• Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;

• Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;

• Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.


Informações da vaga:


Modelo de Trabalho: Híbrido.

Campo Grande - Mato Grosso do Sul.

Horário de Trabalho: 08h as 18h segunda a sexta-feira.


Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!


Saúde e Bem-estar:

• Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;

• Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;

• Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;

• Acesso à plataforma OrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;

• Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas;

• Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida.


Proteção e estabilidade:

• Previdência privada;

• Participação nos lucros;

• Seguro de vida.


Facilidades para o dia a dia:

• Vale-Alimentação;

• Vale-Refeição;

• Carro da empresa;

• Auxílio-Creche;

• Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços.


Desenvolvimento e educação:

• Plataforma de ensino;

• Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições.


Oferecemos salário+comissão e bonificações.


Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.


Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.


Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família.


Para conhecer mais sobre o Grupo Fleury, acesse o site:


O Grupo Fleury informa que a participação em seus processos seletivos é gratuita e nenhuma empresa terceira está autorizada a cobrar valores para a candidatura às vagas, ao treinamento, ao material didático ou qualquer outra despesa relacionada.

title: Dotnet Developer
description:
Job Title: .NET Full Stack Developer – Azure Cloud / ADF / DevOps / SQL

Location: Brazil / Argentina

Remote


Job Description

We are looking for a skilled .NET Developer with strong experience in Azure Cloud services, Azure Data Factory (ADF), DevOps practices, and SQL to design, develop, and maintain scalable cloud-based applications and data integration solutions.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain applications using .NET / .NET Core / ASP.NET / C#
  • Develop and manage Azure Cloud resources and services
  • Build, schedule, and monitor data pipelines using Azure Data Factory (ADF)
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps (Repos, Pipelines, Boards)
  • Write optimized queries, stored procedures, and functions using SQL
  • Ensure application performance, scalability, security, and reliability
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and deliver solutions
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve production issues
  • Follow best practices for coding standards, version control, and documentation


Required Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience in C#, .NET / .NET Core, ASP.NET Web API
  • Experience with Azure Cloud services (App Services, Storage, Functions, etc.)
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF)
  • Experience with Microservices architecture
  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Experience with Azure DevOps for CI/CD and source control
  • Strong knowledge of SQL, performance tuning
  • Experience with REST APIs and integration services
  • Understanding of Agile/Scrum development methodologies

title: JD Edwards (Financial Consultant)
description:
Business Analyst (Financial)


**Add resumes in English**


• Ensure JDE, Trintech, and other financial applications are compliant with Gallagher’s IT Policy. Build plans to enforce compliance with IT policy and standard user management processes.

• Evaluate SOC reports to ensure vendor and application compliance and surface risks.

Skills

Required:

• Relevant experience working with Financial ERP applications, preferably JDE

• Design and Development Experience with JDE

• Experience working with third party vendors to implement SaaS solutions

• Working \"hands-on\" knowledge of Software Development Life Cycle and project management methodologies

• Financial acumen (working knowledge) and awareness of key accounting, financial management and analysis processes, including but not limited to General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Fixed Assets, revenue recognition, budgeting, and bank interfaces

• Strong PC skills, including experience using MS Office Products, especially Excel and Project


Requirements:


• Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering or related field

• Relevant experience with technology project support

• Experience with one or for of the following applications: JDE, Trintech Cadency, Workiva, Cognos Analytics, Analytics, OneStream, and Varicent

• Understanding of Single Sign-On and Identity Management solutions

• Advanced level proficiency with Microsoft Office tools including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio

• Intermediate SQL query skills

• Experience working in large enterprises with domestic and international locations

• Experience working with off-shore or remote development/support teams
